alerts.title: Notice of Public Meeting and Opportunity for Public Testimony Regarding Senate Bill 12 Compliance Certification
alerts.message:
Tuloso-Midway  Independent School District hereby provides notice that the Board of Trustees will consider and may take action on the district’s Annual Certification of Compliance with Certain Laws, as required by Texas Education Code (TEC) § 39.008 and Senate Bill 12, 89th Texas Legislature.

The Board will receive public comments regarding the certification before taking action.

Meeting Date: September 28, 2026
Public Hearing Time: 5:45 pm
Meeting Location: Tuloso-Midway Administration Building, 9760 La Branch, Corpus Christi, Texas 78410

Members of the public are invited to attend and provide testimony in accordance with board policy governing public participation at board meetings.
